correctness.rationale: Explicit Gaussian integration gives p,q,b and the eigenvalue. Since the spectral gap p(0)-q(0)=2Le^{-L²}/sqrt(pi)>0, differentiating the simple top eigenvalue gives F_L(0)=4Le^{-L²}/sqrt(pi)>0 for every positive L. Uniform Taylor/analytic perturbation near a0=1/sqrt2 yields A2 prime(a0)=0, A4 prime(a0)=-sqrt2/(45sqrt(pi e)), the optimizer a_L=a0-sqrt2 L^4/180+O(L^6), and mass 4L/sqrt(pi e)[1-L²/2+41L^4/180+O(L^6)]. Gaussian tails and strict local concavity give exactly ±a_L for sufficiently small L, not for all L. Independent 65-digit central-curvature checks at five widths and optimizer O(L^6) residual at three small widths.
